name: Bifrost Integrations
description: Bifrost Integrations is an open-source automation platform designed to democratize best-in-class tooling for the emerging Integration Services industry - before venture capital gets the chance to own something we’re all incredibly passionate about: solving problems with automation.
implementation_languages: Python, TypeScript, Shell, JavaScript, Jinja, Dockerfile, MDX, Mako
description_good_justification: README.md lines 1-86 explain what Bifrost is, who it's for, and why it exists.
interact_justification: GitHub Issues + Discussions + PRs are the public interaction channels (linked from CONTRIBUTING.md).
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md — 'Before you open a PR' and 'Testing expectations' sections enumerate requirements (tests, type-check, lint, sensitive paths, commit style).

floss_license_osi_justification: The AGPL-3.0 license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
documentation_basics_justification: Some documentation basics file contents found.
documentation_interface_justification: FastAPI auto-generates OpenAPI at /api/docs (Swagger) and /api/redoc; React UI is the human interface.
repo_public_justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs.
repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git can track the changes, who made them, and when they were made.
repo_interim_justification: Active development on main; commits land continuously. See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/commits/main
repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
version_unique_justification: Release workflow requires unique semver tags (v1.2.3). See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/.claude/skills/bifrost-release/SKILL.md.
version_semver_justification: Tags follow semver enforced in CI (refs/tags/v* gate). See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/tags
version_tags_justification: CI publishes semver release bundles on v* git tags (https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml). Cut the first fork tag with the bifrost-release skill, then this criterion is verifiable at https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/tags.
release_notes_justification: Release notes template requires human-readable change summaries (https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/.claude/skills/bifrost-release/SKILL.md). Publish the first GitHub Release at https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/releases when tagging.
release_notes_vulns_justification: bifrost-release skill requires each release body to list fixed CVEs or state none. See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/.claude/skills/bifrost-release/SKILL.md.
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues used as the bug tracker.
report_process_justification: Non-trivial SECURITY[.md] file found file in repository: <https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/SECURITY.md>. [osps_do_02_01]
report_responses_justification: Contributors open bug-fix PRs on https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost; maintainers review and merge or respond. See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/pulls
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests filed as GitHub Issues on https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost receive maintainer engagement. See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/issues
report_archive_justification: https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/issues?q=is%3Aissue — GitHub Issues serves as the public archive. All bug reports, feature requests, RFCs, and responses are permanently retained, publicly accessible without authentication, and full-text searchable. Closed issues remain visible (no deletion). Includes is:closed queries, label filters, and per-issue comment threads.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/SECURITY.md documents private reporting via GitHub private vulnerability advisory at https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/security/advisories/new.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/SECURITY.md mandates private reporting via https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/security/advisories/new. SECURITY.md explicitly states "Do not open a public issue for security reports."
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md states 48-hour acknowledgement and 7-day triage SLA.
build_justification: Docker-based reproducible build via api/Dockerfile and client/Dockerfile; orchestrated by docker-compose.yml and CI.
build_common_tools_justification: Build uses Docker + standard tooling (pip, npm) - widely available open-source toolchain.
build_floss_tools_justification: All build tools are FLOSS: Docker, Python, pip, Node, npm, GitHub Actions runners (Ubuntu).
test_justification: Comprehensive test suite: 386 backend test files (api/tests/{unit,e2e,contract}) and 461 client *.test.ts(x) files.
test_invocation_justification: ./test.sh is the unified test entrypoint - documented in README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.
test_most_justification: Backend has 386 test files covering unit + e2e + contract; client has 461 component/lib tests.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md mandates tests: backend logic to api/tests/unit, e2e for endpoint changes, vitest for components.
tests_are_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md 'Before you open a PR' checklist requires tests for changed code.
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md 'Testing expectations' section explicitly documents the requirement.
warnings_justification: ruff check (api/) and eslint (client/) run in CI lint job; pyright + tsc enforce type warnings.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI lint job fails the build on any ruff/eslint/pyright/tsc error - .github/workflows/ci.yml lint job.
warnings_strict_justification: pyright runs strict-mode in api/; tsc runs with project's strict tsconfig - any new warning fails CI.
know_secure_design_justification: Maintainer has 20 years of MSP/software development experience. Secure-design practices visible in the codebase: multi-tenant data isolation per organization, Fernet-encrypted secret storage, OAuth flow abstraction with token refresh, bcrypt password hashing via pwdlib, no custom crypto, security-focused CI (CodeQL security-and-quality + Scorecard + Dependabot). See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/SECURITY.md
know_common_errors_justification: Maintainer is familiar with OWASP Top 10 and CWE classes. Mitigations visible in the codebase: Pydantic validation on every endpoint (input validation), parameterized SQLAlchemy queries (SQL injection), DOMPurify for HTML rendering (XSS), bcrypt password hashing (cryptographic storage), JWT with proper signing (broken auth), CodeQL security-and-quality pack scans for known CWE classes on every PR. See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
crypto_published_justification: Uses well-known FLOSS crypto: bcrypt (pwdlib) for passwords, Fernet (cryptography lib) for secrets, Sigstore for signing.
crypto_call_justification: Uses pyca/cryptography (Fernet) and pwdlib (bcrypt) - established FLOSS libraries; no custom crypto.
crypto_floss_justification: All crypto deps (cryptography>=47, pwdlib bcrypt, asyncpg TLS, Sigstore cosign) are FLOSS.
crypto_keylength_justification: Bcrypt + Fernet (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256) - both meet/exceed minimums; cryptography>=47 enforces modern defaults.
crypto_working_justification: No known-broken algorithms used (no MD5/SHA-1 for security, no DES); bcrypt for passwords, Fernet AES.
crypto_pfs_justification: All TLS connections use modern stacks that prefer ECDHE cipher suites (PFS by default). httpx, asyncpg, and the React client's fetch all rely on platform/library TLS defaults which negotiate TLS 1.3 or TLS 1.2 with ECDHE. No legacy RSA-key-exchange ciphers configured. See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/api/Dockerfile (python:3.14-slim ships modern OpenSSL).
crypto_password_storage_justification: Passwords hashed with bcrypt via pwdlib (api/src/core/security.py); never stored in plaintext.
crypto_random_justification: Uses Python secrets module (secrets.token_urlsafe) for tokens/state - see api/src/routers/oauth_connections.py etc.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Release artifacts are Sigstore-signed (cosign keyless) + SLSA build provenance. Verification docs in README.md lines 232-263.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: Dependabot weekly + auto-merge for security/patch/minor (.github/dependabot.yml + dependabot-auto-merge.yml); SECURITY.md commits to fast triage.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No known unfixed critical vulns; Dependabot security updates auto-merge on green CI.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL runs on push/PR/weekly with security-and-quality query suite (.github/workflows/codeql.yml).
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security-and-quality pack covers OWASP/CWE classes for Python and TypeScript.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL findings tracked in GitHub Security tab; Scorecard published weekly to securityscorecards.dev.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every push to main, every PR, and weekly cron (https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml).
dynamic_analysis_justification: Playwright E2E tests run on every PR (./test.sh client e2e) against the running React+FastAPI stack. Backend e2e (./test.sh e2e) exercises the API with PostgreSQL/Redis/RabbitMQ containers. See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/test.sh
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Project is written in Python (memory-safe) and TypeScript (memory-safe). No C/C++/unsafe Rust in first-party code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: pytest runs assertions (every `assert` in test code is a runtime check). pyright runs in strict mode. Pydantic validates all API inputs at runtime with full type-shape assertions. Backend dev mode runs with Python's default warning behavior (no -O optimization stripping asserts).
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Medium+ findings from CI/CodeQL/Scorecard are triaged via https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/security and fixed in follow-up PRs.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No SHA-1 or MD5 used for security purposes; no SSH-style CBC mode dependencies. Bcrypt for passwords (pwdlib), Fernet (authenticated AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256) for symmetric encryption, TLS 1.2+ enforced for all network connections, cosign keyless signing for releases. cryptography>=47.0.0 enforces modern algorithm defaults. See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/blob/main/api/src/core/security.py
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: .github/workflows/ci.yml on https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost runs lint + unit + e2e on every push and PR to main.
discussion_justification: GitHub supports discussions on issues and pull requests.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret-scanning + push protection are enabled on https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost (verified via gh api repos/MTG-Thomas/bifrost).
english_justification: All docs (README, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING, CLAUDE) are in English.
maintained_justification: Active development on main with regular merges, Dependabot updates, and CI on every PR. See https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/bifrost/commits/main
OSPS-AC-02.01_justification: Solo-maintainer repo on github.com; new collaborators added through GitHub get the explicit role assigned at invite time (not auto-elevated). GitHub's collaborator UI requires manual permission selection per invite.
OSPS-BR-07.01_justification: GitHub secret-scanning + push protection are both enabled (verified via gh api). Push protection blocks commits containing detected secrets at the git-push layer. .gitignore excludes .env* files.
